items.title: Approve the Minutes of the July 25, 2023 Meeting
Community Advisory Committee Report Consent Agenda
Accept the Transportation Capital Projects Delivery Study
Appoint Phoebe Ford as the District 4 Representative to the Community Advisory Committee
Release $4,687,100 in Previously Allocated Sales Tax Funds, with Conditions, to the Transbay Joint Powers Authority for Downtown Rail Extension Engineering Development and Procurement Preparation
Adopt the Treasure Island Supplemental Transportation Study [NTIP Planning] Final Report
Increase the Amount of Professional Services Contract with WMH Corporation by $350,000, to a Total Amount Not to Exceed $3,050,000
Approve a Two-Year Professional Services Contract with WSP USA Inc. in an Amount Not to Exceed $4,300,000
Investment Report and Debt Expenditure Report for the Quarter Ended June 30, 2023
